correctness.rationale: PASS: for a uniformly sampled 0/1 vertex cloud with N vertices and c_x ones, the ordered-pair coordinate variance is 2c_x(N-c_x)/N². Ideals have count a_x; antichains biject to maximal elements of ideals with count b_x. The factorization follows, b_x≤a_x and b_x≤N-a_x by containment and injective deletion; strictness exactly for a point internal to a three-element chain. For any nonnegative diagonal weights the sum is nonnegative. A 3-chain projection provides a genuine covariance-Loewner counterexample. Independent 1,099 increasing-labeled poset checks corroborate, not replace, the all-poset proof.
